chooserIntro: Kōwhiria te āhua o te taupānga ki tēnei pūrere.
standardHint: Ka puta hei “{name}” me te tohu joliro.
discreetHint: Ka puta me tētahi tohu māmā me te ingoa ka kōwhiria e koe.
signInAgain: Me takiuru anō koe i roto i te taupānga kua tāutahia.
discreetIntro: Ka tāutahia e tēnei he kape āhua noa, ko “{neutral}” te ingoa.
iosStep1: Pātō i te pātene ••• kei raro matau o Safari.
iosStep3: Panuku whakararo, ka pātō i “Add to Home Screen”. Tērā pea me pātō koe i “View More” i te tuatahi.
iosStep4: Waiho kia kā tonu a “Open as Web App”, kātahi ka pātō i “Add”.
iosChrome: Kei te whakamahi koe i a Chrome? Pātō i “Share” kei te pae wāhitau, kātahi i “Add to Home Screen”.
androidChrome: I a Chrome, pātō i te tahua ⋮ kei runga matau, kātahi i “Install app”, i “Add to Home screen” rānei.
androidSamsung: I a Samsung Internet, pātō i te tahua ≡ kei raro matau, kātahi i “Add page to”, kātahi i “Home screen”.
notifyDenied: Kua weto ngā whakamōhiotanga mō tēnei taupānga i ngā tautuhinga o tō waea.
notifyInstallFirst: Tāpirihia te taupānga ki tō Mata Kāinga i te tuatahi, kātahi ka whakakā i ngā whakamōhiotanga i reira.
notifySignIn: Takiuru i te tuatahi, kātahi ka whakakā i ngā whakamōhiotanga.
notifyFailed: Kāore i taea te whakakā i ngā whakamōhiotanga. Whakamātau anō ā muri ake.
offlineBody: Tirohia tō hononga, kātahi ka whakamātau anō.
notificationBody: Whakatuwherahia te taupānga kia kite ai koe.
